text:
Done — I gave the UI a more modern look and split the front-end code into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Refreshed the styling in `public/styles.css`
  - softer background, glassy top bar, better spacing, rounded cards/buttons, improved focus states
- Split shared browser helpers into `public/common.js`
- Broke page-specific logic into smaller files:
  - `public/pages/home.js`
  - `public/pages/login.js`
  - `public/pages/signup.js`
  - `public/pages/post.js`
  - `public/pages/profile.js`
- Simplified the HTML pages so they mostly load shared scripts and page scripts

Notes:
- I kept the app’s functionality the same.
- I also added the missing `public/pages/` structure for the new files.

If you want, I can also do a second pass to tidy the server-side code into smaller route/bootstrap files as well.
